heroHeadline: Trump 'No Hurry' on Iran Deal; Israel Captures Beaufort Castle (Deepest Lebanon Incursion in 26 Years); Iran Imposes Mandatory Hormuz Corridors — Day 93
heroSubtitle: Day 93 (May 31, 2026): The 60-day MoU framework stalled — Trump said in a Fox News interview he was in 'no hurry' to conclude a deal and sent negotiators back with amendments on Hormuz passage, nuclear commitments, and asset-unfreezing sequencing. Iran's chief negotiator Ghalibaf confirmed on Day 92 that 'no understanding has been reached.' Iran hardened its Hormuz posture: on Day 92, the IRGC Khatam al-Anbiya HQ decreed 'full authority' over all strait traffic; on Day 93, Iran formally published mandatory IRGC navigation corridor regulations for all ships — directly contradicting the MoU's 'unrestricted passage' clause. US forces disabled the M/V Lian Star with a Hellfire missile in the Gulf of Oman on Day 92 — the 5th vessel disabled under the blockade. Israel dramatically escalated its Lebanon ground campaign: IDF crossed the Litani River for the first time in nearly 20 years (Day 92), then Israel's Golani Brigade captured Beaufort Castle (Qal'at al-Shqif) on Day 93 — the deepest Lebanese incursion in 26 years. Netanyahu vowed to 'deepen and expand our hold in places under Hezbollah's control.' Lebanon's toll rose to 3,150+ killed. Brent edged up to ~$94/bbl on dampened deal optimism. June 2-3 Doha round remains the nominal diplomatic gate.
